EditorNotes.comment: Not a real PP; merely documenting the Editor's Note convention

problem.para: In the body of the Working Draft, there occasionally appears a point that requires particular attention, highlighted thus:
The definition of URLs used by SQL/MED needs to be reviewed and modernized. In particular, the following areas would benefit from being reviewed:

ulist.item: Support for IPv6 in host numbers. Drafted grammar for this may be found in GQL EWD V5.1.
Considering support for RFC 3987 or a general switch to the newer URL Living Standard produced by WHATWG.

problem.para: Functionality, if any, to support the Vector type needs to be provided.
